## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:openspec`
- [ ] `npm run test:browser` when browser behavior changed
- [ ] `npm run prepublishOnly` when CLI, build, or package behavior changed
- [ ] I manually verified any user-facing change

## Checklist

- [ ] User-facing text and documentation are in English
- [ ] Production behavior changes include focused red/green test evidence
- [ ] No secrets, generated `dist/` files, or local `.openspec-viewer/` notes are included
- [ ] Documentation and changelog entries are updated when relevant
